class Base { protected value = 1; read() { return this.value; } }
class Derived extends Base { public value = 2; }
const base: Base = new Derived();
console.log(base.read());
class Reader { protected read() { return 'base'; } show() { return this.read(); } }
class OpenReader extends Reader { public read() { return 'open'; } }
const reader: Reader = new OpenReader();
console.log(reader.show(), new OpenReader().read());
